question: Which of the following states won the 'Most Film Friendly State Award' at the 67th National Film Awards, 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __​Sikkim__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** won the 'Most Film Friendly State Award' at the 67th National Film Awards, 2019
 
• **Rajat Kamal & Certificate** is provided.
 
• Ahead of the announcement, the Chairperson and other Jury members called on the Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting Shri Prakash Javadekar and presented him with the selections for the Awards.
